patterns: New-model launch day dominates: Claude's Fable 5.2 drove the top AI posts. emollick says early access left him thinking it crosses into 'a sort of Jagged AGI', showing it launch a business, do research and build 3D models (394.8K, 2,799 bookmarks); his 450-world portal experiment (27.4K, 275 bookmarks) and parody game (22.2K); petergyang's head-to-head vs Opus 5.5 across 5 use cases (42.0K); Teknium adding it to Hermes Agent (5.6K).

'Easy to build, hard to earn' tension: levelsio 'It's never been this easy to build software. And never this hard to make money with it' (259.5K, 6,861 likes, 576 replies) is the day's biggest safe one-liner.

AI as a small-business night shift: gregisenberg's launch observations say the model went from doing 21% to 41% of real freelance work and can work 10-12 hours alone, 'basically gives every small business a night shift' (162.6K, 1,309 bookmarks); his AI-agent marketing system thread (79.4K, 2,059 bookmarks, most bookmarked of the day).

Slow diffusion counterpoint: businessbarista says it will take 10+ years for AI to diffuse through most enterprises because of bureaucracy and inertia (22.2K, 218 bookmarks); emollick's 'this time is different' and 1870-1920 living-standards posts (40.2K and 37.3K) frame AI as a possible new growth burst.

Human craft and calm: dickiebush 'planning your day by hand is the best way to keep your ability to think' (19.3K); SahilBloom 'be unapologetically yourself' (63.0K) and the Adjacent Possible (22.2K); his 'robber ducky' dad joke (55.5K).
Recurring words today: Fable 5.2, Jagged AGI, night shift, freelance work, build vs make money, diffusion, enterprises, agents, bookmarks-heavy how-to threads, plan by hand.
